name: EDEN V
source:
Glenn escaped into space and found shelter at another abandoned spacecraft. He notices Shizuka Green among the research team and vows to has his revenge over her.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Glenn逃入太空，在另一艘废弃飞船中找到藏身之处。他注意到研究队里的Shizuka Green，并发誓要向她复仇。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
